title: Corpus dependency graph and foundation analysis contracts, schema contract ladder v0.4
description: Design: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-25-schema-v04-design.md §14 and Appendix A. Reused v0.3 defs are referenced by $id; no field here carries a verification state, and analysis records are nominations, never status (I-1, I-10).

DerivationId.description: §3.3: statement | proof:<digest> | unlocated:<method>:<k> | source:<paper_version_id>:<match_key>; digests are core.digest values (sha256:<hex>).

Stratum.description: §11.2 a sampling stratum: the method and method_version that produced the item and, for a leg, its role and use site. Items of different method versions are never pooled.

Admission.description: §6: how a paper entered the corpus. Only SAMPLE papers are in the estimand population P.

CountBasis.description: I-14: which admitted papers count as dependents; statistics of the two bases are never pooled. Traversal may pass through every admitted paper under either basis.

Rate.description: A proportion (counts may be effective, non-integer sizes) with its Wilson score interval at z; estimate is null when n = 0.

RootClass.description: §8.2 root classes plus the IN_LIBRARY and work-level-claim (WORK_LOCATOR) roots that §8.4 admits in layer_basis.

Layer.description: §4.1 value in N ∪ {∞}; UNRESOLVED only for a pooled work (§8.3).

Bracket.description: Importance bracket (§8.1): lower from legs proposed by >= 2 admitted readings (or the only reading), upper from the union.

effort.description: GPT routes name a reasoning effort; MiMo routes name the thinking mode (thinking-enabled fixes temperature at 1.0).

PaperVersionNode.description: Asserted only by the S1 acquisition delta, from the frozen metadata and the corpus manifest (parser_sha256 = eligibility.parser_sha256); measured yields are GraphDelta.measurements, never row content.

bib_digest.description: digest(normalized title, year, first-author surname) of a BIB_DIGEST work (§5.2), so G6 can recompute its id.

JunctionNode.description: AND over ordered legs; position is the leg's index. OR only across distinct derivation_id values (§3.3). STATEMENT legs only in a statement junction, and at most one statement junction per (conclusion, reading_method, method_version) (G13, host); analysis joins the admitted readings' statement junctions by the establishment reading policy.

Edge.description: Non-logical relationships of §3.6, plus the PREMISE_OF and CONCLUDES rows the projection derives from junctions.

GraphDelta.description: Immutable, content-addressed; delta_id = digest of the body without delta_id. PREMISE_OF and CONCLUDES are derived from junction legs, never asserted as edges. An id asserted by several deltas carries identical rows; method-dependent data lives only in method-scoped rows (readings, junctions) or in measurements. HUMAN_ENTRY (method HUMAN) and LIBRARY_AUDIT (method LIBRARY) carry primitive assertions, work-level claims and entered edges. Only S1 asserts PaperVersion.

measurements.description: Host measurements about the delta subject, never graph content.

deterministic_yield.description: §7 S3 yield of one paper version.

DeltaSetManifest.description: Valid only if closed under parents and every edge endpoint is asserted by an included delta (host check). A correction is a new manifest.

ProjectionManifest.description: Names what Neo4j holds (I-12); readers require READY.

AnalysisPolicy.description: §8.1, frozen per run and digested into every output.

traverse.description: Whose claims enter the graph: SAMPLE papers only, or also EXPANSION and DISCOVERY papers (§6.3).

admission_gate.description: The P0 GateDecision whose admitted methods bound importance_methods (§11.3); a PRIMARY run requires one.

eligibility.description: §6.2 THEOREM_OR_DERIVATION_V1 (host/eligibility.py): eligible iff the S2 parse has at least min_theorem_like theorem-like or definition environments, or at least min_display_equations display equations, so derivation papers without theorem environments are inside P.

coverage.description: §6.4: every accepted paper of every admission receives S6 under `extraction`, and every request whose upstream paper version is in the corpus receives S7; there is no prioritized arm.

extraction.description: The one S6 policy of the corpus; every S6 delta carries its method_version (§7.2).

gates.description: §11 automatic gates, pre-registered at S0 before anything is measured; host/gates.py applies them.

claim_level.description: GO without expansion needs at least min_works works each cited by at least min_citing_papers sample papers (bibliography citations; the in-proof counts are reported beside them).

SamplingRecord.description: §6.2-6.3: one record per sampling round; every examined candidate has exactly one outcome and accepted papers are never replaced.

discovery.description: §6.3 DISCOVERY round: arXiv ids proposed by a model search (corpus.discover), deduplicated against earlier rounds and examined in order_key(seed, id) order up to M; never in the estimand population P.

proposed.description: = dropped_invalid + duplicates + dropped_seen + not_selected + the candidates of the round.

seed.description: Derived by the host from the manifest seed and the round (corpus.discovery_seed), never chosen after the proposals are seen.

NodeMetrics.description: §8.2 metric vector (never one score) for one subject under one (policy, manifest); JSON Lines rows. Not a status (I-10).

dependent_topics.description: Distinct arXiv categories (primary and cross-lists, ARXIV_CATEGORIES_V1) of the counted dependent papers: breadth across topics, reported and never ranked; present for nominated subjects.

FoundationNomination.description: §8.4: a nomination for Stage 3 work, never a status (I-10).

ReviewSample.description: §11 P0 labelling sample; inclusion probabilities allow inverse-inclusion weighting. Labels come from an AUTO_PANEL of judges under one EvaluationPlan (the default) or from humans (an optional audit of the panel).

HumanReviewV4.description: The v0.3 HumanReview shape with the v0.4 subject kinds added.

EvaluationPlan.description: §11.2 AUTO_EVAL_V1, frozen before any judge call: the sample, the controls that calibrate the panel, the judges and how their verdicts combine. The thresholds live in CorpusManifest.gates.P0, fixed at S0.

negative.description: count_per_rule decoys of every rule for each precision estimand; the false-positive rate is taken per rule and the largest upper bound is used.

decision_rule.description: A card is panel-positive iff every judge returns a VALID USED verdict; anything else is not positive.

producers.description: Per judge operation, the models that produced the judged items (leg.judge: the S6 extraction models; match.judge: the S7 match models).

Judgement.description: One judge's verdict on one blinded card (§11.2): a measurement by a declared instrument, never a disposition (I-0, I-15). USED counts only with a quotation the host bound inside the card's evidence text (I-7).

receipt.description: The receipt of the judge call that produced the response.

PrecisionEstimate.description: §11.2 one stratum. lower_bound = (lower(panel_positive) - fpr_inflation * upper(false_positive)) / (1 - fpr_inflation * upper(false_positive)), which holds for any panel sensitivity <= 1: a one-sided 1 - alpha bound (Bonferroni over two one-sided Wilson bounds). false_positive is the decoy rule of false_positive_by_rule with the largest upper bound. point is the Rogan-Gladen estimate with the control sensitivity and no inflation.

RecallEstimate.description: §11.2 recall without a gold proof set, each under its stated assumption: ANCHOR_REFERENCED_V1 (explicitly referenced premises only), UNION_OF_TWO_METHODS_V1 (within the panel-confirmed union of two methods), CAPTURE_RECAPTURE_CHAPMAN_V1 (assumes independent detection; optimistic when misses correlate).

EvaluationReport.description: §11.2 AUTO_EVAL_V1 estimates from one plan's judgements: an automatic measurement labelled AUTO_PANEL, with its assumptions listed; never a human label and never a status.

distinct_model_present.description: true iff every judged operation has a judge whose model produced none of the judged items.

inputs.description: What the estimates were computed from: the samples, digests of the cards and judgements, and per precision estimand the control composition (positive controls, decoys per rule, base legs or junctions skipped for want of a decoy).

GateDecision.description: §11 automatic gate: the rule pre-registered in CorpusManifest.gates applied to recorded measurements. A decision about what runs next, never a status of any claim (I-10).

PricingProfile.description: Provider prices and limits as published on a dated page (§1.1); read by host/cost.py, never by a model. Prices are per million tokens.

CostProjection.description: §1.1 host projection of S6 cost and wall-clock time for planned papers; every parameter carries its provenance label. A plan, not a measurement.

paper_plans.description: MEASURED: every paper's calls, focus bytes and prefix bytes came from the host's prompt builder; MODELLED: from source bytes and the parameters. parameters lists only the parameters the formulas used.

wallclock_basis.description: Real time: max(calls / rpm, tokens / tpm). Batch: the provider's stated completion window for jobs submitted together (the pages state no job concurrency limit).

ceiling.description: under_ceiling iff projected + other_stages + already_spent <= value, all in the ceiling's unit.

other_stages.description: Reserve for S7, AUTO_EVAL_V1 and DISCOVERY calls of the run.

already_spent.description: The ledger's spent() at projection time.
